        "scope": "Blender5.2.3 runtime compatibility plus typed scene production, named assets/hierarchy, animation/rigging, reviewed node graphs, bounded physics, inferred-pivot presentation and independently checked frame/geometry outputs. Strategic application coverage remains unfinished. Native packed project/binary and embedded glTF asset reuse, explicit STL/PLY/OBJ/baked USD assets and direct scene-production route are included by the follow-up review. Typed mesh/scientific fields and named UV mapping/packing with explicit copy/shared ownership extend the declared scope; whole Blender remains incomplete. Typed geometry resources select Objects, asset parts and complete collections; native dependency/expansion admission protects procedural compositions. Ordered finite mesh selection/edit replay covers bounded topology before scientific fields and modifiers; further mesh operators and data propagation remain required. Curve/builtin-font resource admission bounds preview and render sampling together, including supported later-key envelopes. Editable classic POLY/Bezier/NURBS multi-spline controls, planar fills, round/custom/profile-Object sweeps, taper dependencies and fixed path consumers extend bounded modelling; broader curve editing and free quarter-profile handles remain incomplete. Typed Cycles/EEVEE/Workbench engine intent, display transforms and distinct material/object/mesh-attribute colours extend rendering; broader rendering, probe/cache, OCIO and pass/output families remain incomplete. Captured single-file image previews select independent material display images, alpha interpretation and active UVs; broader texture painting and rendering remain incomplete. Named surface layouts assign Mesh faces, classic splines and text characters under explicit DATA ownership; linked Object palettes preserve shared geometry. Whole material/Blender coverage and final independent integration gates remain incomplete. Layered artist surface intent compiles reusable material/texture roles with shared stored UV normal bases, finite physical layers and renderer-specific applicability; painting, baking, UDIM and broader shader workflows remain unfinished. Finite public render bundles add named view layers, CPU scientific EXR planes and Cryptomatte, managed PNG/EXR output, logical Material/World AOV taps and captured collection masks. Cycles Freestyle adds bounded technical lines. Explicit rigid-packed and cloth-packed/disk requests add freshly reconstructed all-frame cache verification. Whole Blender remains incomplete.",
        "review": [

      "context": {
        "purpose": "Build editable 3D assets, material and procedural node graphs, hierarchy, rigged motion, bounded physics and product presentation frames with independently checked geometry handoffs. Render with explicit Cycles, EEVEE or Workbench shading and a declared display transform.",
        "assumptions": "The implementation currently requires Blender 5.2.3. Coordinates are Blender world coordinates; import scale is explicit and rotations follow the declared operation conventions.",
        "constraints": "One declared scene with bounded analytic expansion. Typed production covers curated assets, channels, nodes, rigs, rigid bodies and cloth; important remaining families stay open in the capability map. Production verification requires a trusted configured Blender executable. Outputs bake evaluated frame geometry and explicitly record physical units and losses. Nondefault inactive legacy Cycles/world/light settings are refused on other engines. EEVEE/Workbench conservatively reserve one graphics slot; this does not prove a particular physical device. Custom OCIO configurations, EEVEE probe/cache authoring remain unfinished. Artist samplers reference captured images and local roles. Numeric RGB/normal inputs require Non-Color; scalar alpha cannot use ignored alpha. Smart requires built-in OSL on CPU/OptiX. Stored UV copy transforms refuse native feature loss and cannot pack in the same step. Tangent normal orientation follows the chosen stored UV frame, independently of sampler lookup transforms. Native geometry drivers remain refused by the current material-input dependency contract; bake supported Action channels before asset reuse. Classic Curve selection/hide flags remain conservative source inputs. Scientific raw-plane identity is qualified on fixed CPU Cycles; general beauty PNG/EXR verification binds source and layout rather than arbitrary image equality. Generic AOV fields must avoid reserved Cycles names. Projected captures require the admitted finite local hierarchy; nested instances/deformers/drivers are refused. Freestyle uses the declared finite Cycles subset. Only complete-timeline rigid-packed and cloth-packed/disk caches are admitted; rigid-disk, inherited arbitrary baked caches, broader simulations, Grease Pencil Line Art, procedural skies and World volumes remain unsupported or unfinished.",
        "inspection": "Inspect native persisted object/node/rig/animation records, independently calculated linear/constant motion, repeated native physics evaluation, frame PNG decode and fresh geometry import. Verification reopens current project bytes with trusted code; receipt executable paths are never execution authority. Native readback checks engine/display/shading controls and active/render colour selectors. Independent qualification checks encoded sRGB/exposure and distinct colour-source pixels; general verification is not an arbitrary image rerender oracle. Imported asset fidelity is compared directly with fresh trusted construction from captured inputs and authorised scene edits; submitted readbacks are not source authority. Active UV/colour selectors, FOLLOW_SCENE output colour and Workbench surface mode are independently bound. Asset integer types/values and recursively typed custom metadata compare exactly; only native floating-point settings use rounding tolerance. Preview image pointers, interpretation, packed payloads and helper state are bound independently of shader graphs. General verification does not rerender arbitrary images. Pinned workflow inputs are admitted only at declared single-file resource positions. Material assignment reconstructs declared/captured inputs before submitted native open and binds exact shared data identity, DATA/OBJECT links, palette pointers, surface indices and all owners. Slot order is authored through logical IDs, not inferred from source names. Reviewed shader signatures include Cycles renderer settings and explicit Line Art/Grease Pencil style structs. Host planning and captured native admission bound distinct shader nodes, recursively repeated instances, aggregate material expansion and group depth; a small unique graph is not an expansion-cost oracle. Inspect actual layer graphs, image roles, named/render-active UVs and linked DATA/Object material ownership; use the separate Fresnel, Snell, Lambert/TBN, channel and displacement qualifiers for their documented literal oracles.",
        "recovery": "UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME needs the configured supported Blender release. Fix material/dependency or input-format faults during planning; retain native logs for modifier/render errors and use a fresh run. UNSUPPORTED_HANDOFF means the producer does not publish the required scene or images. RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND means restore the source file; INVALID_RESOURCE requires a regular file; RESOURCE_UNREADABLE means check permissions and storage. VERIFICATION_RUNTIME_REQUIRED needs trusted application configuration for fresh production verification. INVALID_INTENT needs an unanimated hierarchy root for presentation control. RESOURCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED requires lower procedural resolution or simulation span. INVALID_MESH_DATA needs correct field/domain/mapping shapes. SHARED_MESH_DATA needs explicit copy/shared policy and one coherent write per Mesh. AMBIGUOUS_MESH_TARGET needs a unique native/glTF sourceObject or single-mesh asset. UV_MAPPING_FAILED requires inspecting native topology/seams and retained logs. INVALID_SPLINE needs compatible dimensional fill/knot/handle/profile/taper controls. NATIVE_VALUE_MISMATCH requires recentering or rescaling small controls and avoiding underflowing weights. Custom profile controls need distinct normalized points; imported FREE/ALIGN profile handles need a future reviewed readback mapping. INVALID_SCENE requires nonempty evaluated geometry; a Curve component on a Mesh target needs curveToMesh before geometric observation or export. Partial trimming requires constant point radius along each spline; shorten control geometry before sweeping when radius varies. INEFFECTIVE_RENDER_SETTING requires the selected engine options, world-space Studio rotation or enabled ray tracing for fast GI. INVALID_RENDERER requires nonzero shadow direction and at least one enabled filter when filtering. DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE requires an installed supported Cycles backend. TYPE_MISMATCH on displayColour requires a geometric Object prototype. Unsupported custom OCIO/presets need a future captured-resource policy. Image inputs require regular readable files within encoded/pixel budgets. Deliberate saved edits need a new adopted snapshot; changed pinned bytes cannot be silently reused. INVALID_MATERIAL_ASSIGNMENT requires complete logical slots and nonempty disjoint regions. SHARED_MATERIAL_DATA requires explicit copy/shared ownership or one coherent layout. MATERIAL_LAYOUT_IDENTITY requires a distinct Object sharing the exact declared layout data. AMBIGUOUS_MATERIAL_TARGET requires one unique source part. Full-domain material selection scans and aggregate owner/element readback have finite work budgets. RERUN_REQUIRED on asset-fidelity/1 means preserve the old proof and rerun authored intent into NEW output using retained trusted original asset inputs (explicitly adopt those bytes if necessary); do not resnapshot the submitted consumer or relabel its witness. Raw original assets remain reusable. Missing/unknown fidelity versions fail verification. Shader RESOURCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED requires at most 8,192 distinct nodes, 8,192 expanded material occurrences and 32 nested groups; simplify repeated branches or nesting, including unused declarations. UNSUPPORTED_SHADER_BACKEND needs Cycles OSL for Smart and CPU/OptiX with an OSL-enabled runtime. UNSUPPORTED_SURFACE_RENDERER needs a supported engine or effective layer choice. Source mismatch after a changed UVsphere constructor requires preserved old evidence and a NEW run from trusted authored/original inputs; no tolerant or submitted-state resnapshot fallback. RESERVED_AOV_ATTRIBUTE requires renaming the geometry field and its AOV source together (for example sx_temperature), preserving the logical pass if desired, then rerunning trusted intent into NEW output. MISSING_AOV_ATTRIBUTE requires the declared compatible field on every effective owner/geometry, including clamped face slots and converted objects. Changed scientific planes, Cryptomatte membership or cache payloads require preserved evidence and a new trusted construction; refreshed hashes or submitted witnesses do not authorise them."
